prediction_text: He will obtain the office/preferment desired. The Moon in the tenth applying to a trine of Saturn, Saturn exalted in the Ascendant with mutual reception with Venus (querent), perfects the matter through a powerful/solar patron; the pretended friend (Sun, lord of 11th, in 7th opposite Ascendant with Dragon's Tail) is false and will hinder or claim credit, but does not defeat the appointment. Time window: on the Moon-Saturn trine perfecting, within weeks of the question (month scale, main point the applying trine's perfection).
basis: Horary (Lilly): Asc+Venus querent, 10th office; Moon in 10th applying trine Saturn exalted in Asc, Venus-Saturn mutual reception = perfection; Sun lord 11th in 7th opp Asc with Cauda = false friend noted separately.
